report_title: Sahaay AI Vision V4 Annotation Infrastructure & Progress Summary

inter_annotator_agreement.rationale: Cohen's Kappa requires independent, paired human annotations on real-world collected imagery. Reporting a target of >= 0.85 as achieved prior to genuine data collection is scientifically prohibited. Computation will execute automatically upon ingestion of the first paired cohort.

audit_conclusion: Annotation schema, dual-review guidelines, and validation templates are verified. Production annotation is paused pending execution of municipal MOUs and citizen portal launch.
